title: 小火车出发
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE finished professional SIMPLE children's coloring-book illustration, square 1024x1024, for an Android tablet coloring game ages 5–12. Expert illustrator's warm expressive organic drawing with confident flowing curves, tasteful varied line weight and charming asymmetry; never geometric clip-art parts or a diagram. Make the main character or vehicle big, around 70–80% of the image, with a memorable playful pose and one clear amusing story beat. Only 10–16 LARGE enclosed white colorable shapes across the ENTIRE picture, hard maximum 20 including the background. Keep every colorable area broad and easy for a child's finger, no tiny enclosed islands. Use expressive solid-black simple eyes WITHOUT tiny white highlights, and open smile curves; large simple facial shapes. Omit decorative texture, fur tufts, narrow stripes, dense details, screws, tiny windows, scales, grass blades, confetti and background ornaments. Add only 1–2 BIG simple secondary props that support the scene. Background nearly empty WHITE, perhaps one broad sweeping ground/cloud curve and one large simple sun/star, never a detailed scene. Crisp clean bold BLACK outlines on pure WHITE: roughly 6px outer contours and 4px interior at 1024px, continuous CLOSED boundaries, generous blank coloring areas. No gray shading, color, gradient, hatching, sketch/construction marks, paper texture, text, logo, border, or watermark. Keep main subject and appendages inside safe white margins; no cropped character. Finished professional Q-cute children's picture-book ink line art: simpler linework and fewer bigger color blocks, lively and lovable rather than mechanically assembled.

Scene: ONE cheerful rounded little locomotive chugs forward with a playful forward-leaning pose and simple friendly face. Exactly THREE large simple wheels without concentric hubs, ONE large cab window, and ONE or TWO big soft steam puffs. One broad flowing locomotive body, one simple chimney; no carriages, no rails, no sleepers, no piston rods, no bolts, no grille and no small mechanical ornaments. Empty white background. Keep the drawing organic and charming, not an engineering diagram. 10–16 broad enclosed coloring areas, hard maximum 20 across the entire image including background.

FINAL SIMPLIFICATION OVERRIDE: Only ONE big steam cloud. ONE smooth integrated locomotive body, ONE cab window, ONE broad plain chimney. THREE big single-outline wheels: NO inset hubs or double rims, NO wheel rods. NO cab-roof border strip, NO circular face bezel, NO boiler stripes, NO double bumper, NO small triangle joints. Friendly face is two solid eyes and ONE OPEN U-shaped smile stroke, NOT an enclosed mouth or tongue. Enclosed white shapes must all be broad, at least 6 percent of the image width across; place the wheels so their surrounding gaps stay open to the background rather than forming tiny trapped pockets. A lively tilted whole silhouette, NOT multiple stacked engineering parts. Empty background without ground line. Plan only 8–12 total colorable shapes including background, never over 16.

EDIT THE PROVIDED IMAGE ONLY. Preserve the charming train silhouette, friendly face, one steam cloud, cab window, three wheel positions, clean line quality and all other composition exactly. On EACH of the THREE wheels, erase the extra curved arc that creates a thin crescent of wheel thickness: keep exactly ONE smooth oval contour per wheel and plain broad white interior, no double rim anywhere. Remove only these three narrow depth slivers; do not add hubs or new details. Keep pure black ink on pure white. This is a targeted simplification of the existing illustration, not a fresh composition.
visualReview: Accepted after inspecting both original PNG and all numbered region masks: expressive simple professional line art; major subject areas closed and separate from background; no narrow mechanical rings or omitted excess regions.
